description: A faint, low‐relief rectangular enclosure (~1.0 × 1.2 km) with continuous berm ridges visible in LiDAR hillshade. Alignment is orthogonal (N–S/E–W), and slope/curvature filters isolate the walls as subtle convex linear features. In Sentinel-2 VIS there is a faint tonal shift along the berm, and in NIR a narrow, darker signature indicates higher moisture—characteristic of silt‐and‐charcoal-enriched ditch fills. No modern infrastructure overlaps in the OSM layer.

An L-shaped channel segment (~800 m EW arm, ~600 m NS arm) forming a right‐angle corner. The feature appears as a negative relief lineament with paired slight embankments in the DTM derivatives. Sentinel-2 NIR shows a narrow band of reduced reflectance along the depression, suggesting persistent soil moisture or dark‐earth fill. Absent from OSM basemap.
